items.rationale: Single-pass URL decoding in _normalize_requested_path allows double-encoded traversal payloads (e.g. %252e%252e%252f) to bypass the .. component check. Fixed by repeatedly decoding until stable and checking .. as a path component rather than a substring.

AppSec confirmed exploit reproduces through encoded separators and symlink escapes. Fix resolves the double-encoding bypass and adds checks for absolute paths and drive-qualified paths. Nested exports under tenant root remain functional.
JWT key rotation is out of scope for this hotfix. AppSec review confirms it should be rotated later and not folded into this patch.
JWT material rotation deferred per AppSec guidance; not part of this hotfix.
